text: Tersio 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 网页端的编码助手效率插件。它向会话提示词加入可切换的 Caveman、Ponytail、pstack 与 Headroom 模式，并可组合常用预设；RTK 模式会压缩支持的 shell 输出，也提供命令工具。网页状态栏可查看并切换模式，斜杠命令和 MCP 工具可管理设置、查看代理用量与会话数据。适合希望精简回复和命令结果、管理编码助手模式并了解使用量的 DSH 用户。无需额外密钥；RTK 输出压缩需要本机安装 rtk，未启用时命令按普通方式运行。

Tersio adds prompt and shell modes to DeepSeek Harness. Presets combine Caveman, Ponytail, pstack and Headroom; RTK condenses supported shell output. A status bar and slash commands switch modes. MCP tools expose settings, usage and sessions. No API key is needed; RTK requires its local binary.

Tersio 的组合模式「Combo」：将 Caveman、RTK 与 Ponytail 按 off、lite、balanced 或 max 预设一起切换。用户可使用 /combo 命令，也可通过网页状态栏的选项设置。
Tersio 的提示词模式「Caveman、Ponytail 与 pstack」：按所选级别将对应规则加入 DSH 系统提示词。Caveman 与 Ponytail 可选精简强度，pstack 单独启用。
Tersio 的命令输出功能「RTK」：开启后，在 bash 工具执行前重写受支持的命令，并提供 rtk_run 工具。命令参数为 shell 命令；RTK 未开启时由普通 shell 执行。
Tersio 的界面功能「模式状态栏」：状态栏在对话输入框下方显示组合预设和各模式状态。点击后可选择 Combo 预设或逐项调整模式，切换结果保存为 DSH 专属默认值。
Tersio 的 MCP 功能「用量与会话查询」：通过 stdio MCP 工具读取请求、错误、token、缓存率、费用、模型和最近会话；还可查看活动记录及各 agent 的接入状态。
Tersio 的模式管理功能「MCP 设置」：MCP 工具可读取或保存 Combo、Caveman、RTK、Ponytail、pstack 与 Headroom 默认值，并能针对一个 agent 设置覆盖值。
Tersio 的使用前须知：Headroom 模式跟踪用户自己的 Headroom 安装；其默认关闭，且 DSH 提示词中的压缩指引只在相应代理路由可用时生效（见 extensions/headroom/index.ts:1-22）。

Token saver & usage tracker for coding agents: terse caveman replies, compact RTK shell output, lean Ponytail code, Headroom compression, pstack rigor, and a gain dashboard — one-command combos over one shared extension tree.

@krtclcdy/tersio README · 🎯 What this is, and why you would use it：Coding agents bill you per token. Three of the costs you never asked for:

- **Replies carry filler.** The same three sentences, plus a greeting, a hedge, a recap, and a "hope this helps".
- **Shell output is noise.** A failing test prints hundreds of lines to reach the four that matter.
- **The rules repeat every turn.** Your agent re-reads its instructions on every single turn.

Tersio installs into Oh My Pi, Pi, Pi-in-go, OpenCode, and DeepSeek Harness, and cuts those costs:
section: 🎯 What this is, and why you would use it

text:
@krtclcdy/tersio README · 🎯 What this is, and why you would use it：| Mode | What it does for you |
|---|---|
| 🪨 **Caveman** | Shorter replies. Answer first, filler gone, and code, commands, paths, and errors stay exact. |
| 🗜️ **RTK** | Condensed shell output, every signal kept. A failing test still names the test, the assertion, and the line. |
| 🧠 **Ponytail** | Leaner code. YAGNI: no feature, option, or abstraction nobody asked for, and the shortest diff that still works. |
| 🥔 **pstack** | Rigor mode. It applies a design principle when the moment fits, and owns the approach, the check, and the design. Opt-in, on its own switch. |
| 🍃 **Headroom** | Headroom shrinks tool output, file reads, and history. Opt-in; Tersio reads its savings and never turns it on for you. |
| 🧩 **Combo** | One command sets Caveman, RTK, and Ponytail, at three strengths. |
| 📊 **Dashboard** | What you spent, per model and per day. |

@krtclcdy/tersio README · ⚡ Getting Started：All install paths in one table, with update and remove commands: [INSTALL.md](./INSTALL.md).

**Default** (macOS/Linux) — one line. Installs the CLI via npm, then runs the main installer (scope + Combo preset menus) in the same pass:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/KurutoDenzeru/tersio/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh
```

**Windows** — one line, the same pass through PowerShell:

@krtclcdy/tersio README · ⚡ Getting Started：```powershell
irm https://github.com/KurutoDenzeru/tersio/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex
```

Then run the CLI. Bare `tersio` opens a menu and asks which agent to install into:

```bash
tersio                      # menu — picks Oh My Pi, pi, OpenCode, Pi-in-go, or DeepSeek Harness
tersio install --host pi    # pi, non-interactive
tersio install --host omp   # Oh My Pi, non-interactive
tersio install --host opencode  # OpenCode, non-interactive

@krtclcdy/tersio README · ⚡ Getting Started：Or let each host install the package itself:

```bash
omp plugin install @krtclcdy/tersio
pi install npm:@krtclcdy/tersio
opencode plugin add @krtclcdy/tersio
pig install npm:@krtclcdy/tersio

The DeepSeek Harness desktop app installs through its Plugins pane instead: **Add plugin** → paste `@krtclcdy/tersio`, or a local checkout path while the bundle field is unreleased → restart the app. `dsh plugin` refuses the `desktop` profile by design, and `tersio install --host dsh` never writes it.

@krtclcdy/tersio README · ⚡ Getting Started：Pick one install method per host, not both. Using both registers every command twice.

All hosts load the same six extensions from the same sources and read their session-start defaults from `~/.tersio/settings.json`. All six load always.

One-off use without installing:

```bash
npm exec --yes --prefer-online --package=@krtclcdy/tersio@latest -- tersio install
```

@krtclcdy/tersio README · Requirements：| Need | Detail |
|---|---|
| Host | [OMP](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi), [pi](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi), [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai), [PiG](https://pi-in-go.dev), or [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — `tersio install --host <omp\|pi\|opencode\|pig\|dsh>` |
| Node.js | 20.12+ with npm. The CLI runs under Node |
| Bun | Optional. Preferred when on PATH, npm otherwise; also supplies SQLite in process |
| SQLite | Bun, Node 22.5+ `node:sqlite`, or the `sqlite3` binary on PATH |
| OS | macOS, Linux, or Windows, native (`install.ps1`). WSL works too, installed from inside it |
@krtclcdy/tersio README · 🧪 Benchmarks：One model, `GLM-5.3-Flash`, five runs per prompt. Method: [docs/BENCHMARK.md](./docs/BENCHMARK.md).

@krtclcdy/tersio README · 🧪 Benchmarks：Base: 119 reply tokens, 1,616 total, 11 of 15. Agentic base: 40,176 tokens at 135.5s (pstack, RTK) and 70,784 at 150.3s (combo stacks). Agentic rows rest on 1 to 5 runs, so read them as smoke tests; no bill savings are claimed. Per-mode files: [Caveman](./docs/BENCH_CAVEMAN.md), [Ponytail](./docs/BENCH_PONYTAIL.md), [pstack](./docs/BENCH_PSTACK.md), [RTK](./docs/BENCH_RTK.md), [Headroom](./docs/BENCH_HEADROOM.md), [Combo](./docs/BENCH_COMBO.md), [Combo + Headroom](./docs/BENCH_COMBO_HEADROOM.md), [Combo + pstack](./docs/BENCH_COMBO_PSTACK.md), [Combo + all](./docs/BENCH_COMBO_ALL.md).

@krtclcdy/tersio README · 🔌 MCP：That is the whole setup. No extra command, no port, no token, and no process to keep alive. `tersio install` writes this same Tersio server entry into OMP, Pi, PiG, and OpenCode, and asks first — the prompt reads `Add the Tersio MCP server to <agent>? … (optional)`, so a machine that should stay untouched can decline. DeepSeek Harness needs no file: its bundle patch carries the entry, and it is wired as soon as the plugin is mounted.

@krtclcdy/tersio README · 🔌 MCP：The entry names an absolute `tersio` path when the binary is findable at install time, because an agent launched from the desktop never reads a shell profile and would not see the bare name. The bare name stays as the fallback.

@krtclcdy/tersio README · 🔌 MCP：Six tools become available: `tersio_stats` (requests, errors, tokens, cache rate, and cost for a range, in your display currency), `tersio_activity` (what Tersio changed, newest first), `tersio_hosts` (every supported agent, its installed version, and whether the MCP entry reaches it), `tersio_sessions` (the newest sessions with host, project, model, tokens, and cost), `tersio_modes` (read the session-start defaults, or set them: a Combo preset, or any single mode — caveman, rtk, ponytail, pstack, headroom — overriding its piece of the preset; pass `host` to scope the read or the write to one agent), and `tersio_headroom` (savings by default; `action: status` for live proxy counters and routing; `action: retrieve` with a marker hash; or `action: memory`, `evals`, and `dashboard` for the upstream commands Tersio does not reimplement).

@krtclcdy/tersio README · 🔌 MCP：Two resources read without spending a tool call: `tersio://settings` (the stored profile) and `tersio://hosts` (the host table with live state). A client that cancels a request stops the tool with it, so a long `evals` run does not keep the process busy after the call is gone.

@krtclcdy/tersio README · 🖥️ CLI：| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `tersio install` | Install (user scope: all OMP sessions) |
| `tersio update` | Update the Tersio CLI. `--host <agent>` also refreshes that agent's extensions and add-ons (Caveman rule, Headroom, Ponytail) and reports a newer rtk release; no prompt is asked |
| `tersio doctor` (Defaults row) | `tersio doctor` prints the shared defaults and each agent's overrides, so a value's source is visible without reading the store |
| `tersio doctor` | Check OMP, extension, Ponytail, RTK, and OpenCode service health (`--fix` repairs, `--fix=<scope>` one scope, `--dry-run` previews) |
| `tersio dashboard` | Open the Dashboard (`--open`, `--export <file>`, `--port <n>`, `--currency <code>`; serves localhost only) |
| `tersio mcp` | Start the Tersio MCP server on stdio (see [MCP](#-mcp)) |
| `tersio uninstall` | Remove extensions, registrations, the Ponytail plugin, and the `rtk.ts` OMP wiring (`--keep-ponytail` keeps Ponytail; `--remove-rtk` also removes that wiring, never the binary) |
| `tersio version` | Print version |

@krtclcdy/tersio README · 🖥️ CLI：Flags: `--dry-run`, `--yes`/`-y`, `--verbose`, `--combo-default`/`--caveman-default`/`--rtk-default`/`--ponytail-default`/`--pstack-default`/`--headroom-default`, `--currency <code>` (usage/dashboard display currency; flag wins, then the dashboard's own default, then USD). Legacy `--doctor` / `--uninstall` forms still work.

@krtclcdy/tersio README · ⌨️ Commands reference：Mode switches live on their own commands; bare `/tersio` prints status. Every mode command, and every session start, prints the status line:

```
🧩 COMBO MAX: 🪨 caveman=ULTRA | 🗜️ rtk=ON | 🍃 headroom=ON | 🧠 ponytail=ULTRA | 🥔 pstack=ON
```

It is display-only — it never enters the model context, so it costs the session nothing.

@krtclcdy/tersio README · ⌨️ Commands reference：| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `/combo off\|lite\|balanced\|max\|status` | One preset for caveman, RTK, and Ponytail. pstack and headroom stay separate. |
| `/caveman lite\|full\|ultra\|megacave-lite\|megacave-full\|megacave-ultra\|off\|status` | [Caveman](https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman) reply levels. Legacy `wenyan` names still work. |
| `/rtk on\|off\|status` | [RTK](https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk) shell output. Exact bytes skip it. |
| `/ponytail off\|lite\|full\|ultra\|status` | [Ponytail](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail) code levels. |
| `/pstack on\|off\|status` | [pstack](https://github.com/cursor/plugins/tree/main/pstack) rigor mode. Opt-in; `normal mode` clears it. |
| `/headroom on\|off\|status` | [Headroom](https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom) compression. Opt-in; Tersio reads its savings and never installs it silently. |
| `/tersio status` | Active modes and combo level. |
| `/tersio update <ponytail\|rtk\|caveman\|all> [--dry-run]` | Update add-ons. |
| `/tersio dashboard` | Open the dashboard. |
| `/tersio help` | This table. |

@krtclcdy/tersio README · 🗂️ Files and backups：| What | Path |
|---|---|
| Session defaults | `~/.tersio/settings.json` — combo, caveman, rtk, ponytail, pstack, headroom, and currency. `hosts.<agent>` overrides one agent; `inherit` restores the shared value |
| RTK binary | Not Tersio's: whatever `rtk` resolves to on `PATH` (or `~/.bun/bin`). rtk installs and updates it |
| Ledger and caches | `~/.tersio/usage.db` — usage rows, prices, scorecard, state, Headroom records, and layout. Local only |
| Activity log | `~/.tersio/activity.jsonl` — one line per change, as the Logs page reads it |
| Host scope | The same `usage.db` mirrors omp, pi, and OpenCode sessions, split by host and agent kind |
| Snapshots | `~/.tersio/backups/` — one hashed `.snap` each, fourteen kept, carrying `usage.db` whole |

@krtclcdy/tersio README · 🗂️ Files and backups：The installer writes `<file>.bak` before it replaces a source. `tersio doctor --fix extensions` restores a damaged tree, and `doctor --fix registrations` drops retired or duplicate `config.yml` entries.

@krtclcdy/tersio README · 🗂️ Files and backups：Settings → **Data** holds snapshots, the backup schedule, retention (7 days to Forever; older usage rows drop on the next sync; transcripts stay), and Reset behind Advanced. Restore saves the current state first, then copies the snapshot over the live files; delete never touches live data. Both ask first, name what they change, and leave files outside the snapshot untouched. Reset confirms, clears the ledger and its RTK rows, hides the summary, and keeps transcripts, rtk history, and prices.
@krtclcdy/tersio README · 🗂️ Files and backups：Active modes reassert after Ponytail's prompt block on every top-level turn, including after history compaction.

@krtclcdy/tersio README · 🛠️ Troubleshooting：**Ponytail or Combo command missing on OMP:** confirm `~/.omp/plugins/package.json` lists `@krtclcdy/tersio`, then run `tersio install`, restart OMP, and check `tersio doctor`. A damaged tree is repaired by `tersio doctor --fix extensions`.

@krtclcdy/tersio README · 🛠️ Troubleshooting：**RTK missing:** rtk is part of Tersio, so `tersio install` runs rtk's own quick install for you — `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rtk-ai/rtk/master/install.sh | sh` on macOS/Linux, `winget install rtk-ai.rtk` on Windows — then binds it, reading `~/.local/bin` even before your shell picks it up. If that install cannot run, it prints rtk's install page — [rtk-ai.app/docs/getting-started/installation](https://www.rtk-ai.app/docs/getting-started/installation/) — and finishes everything else.

@krtclcdy/tersio README · 🛠️ Troubleshooting：**Headroom installed somewhere unusual:** point Tersio at the binary with `TERSIO_HEADROOM_BIN=/path/to/headroom`; the install and the routing both read it.

@krtclcdy/tersio README · 🛠️ Troubleshooting：**RTK savings and adoption:** the Gain numbers read rtk's own `history.db` (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\rtk` on Windows), so pi and OpenCode runs are already in them. The adoption row counts executed Bash calls from the omp and pi transcripts and OpenCode's v2 sqlite or pre-v2 JSON tree. The eligible list comes from `rtk rewrite`, cached per binary version. Native tool calls (`read`/`edit`/`eval`) and exact bytes bypass RTK.

@krtclcdy/tersio README · 🛠️ Troubleshooting：**RTK update available:** `tersio update` and the dashboard report the version rtk upstream ships. Tersio never installs it; update rtk with its own installer.
